meta.title: Nursery Rhyme
meta.description: For the first time, she sings it in its entirety.

units.rawText: In the Oasis' Medical Department.
units.displayText: In the Oasis' Medical Department.

spans.text: In the Oasis' Medical Department.

units.rawText: Where is this place? Where is my zoo?
units.displayText: Where is this place? Where is my zoo?

spans.text: Where is this place? Where is my zoo?

units.rawText: You're in the Medical Department of the Oasis Zoo.
units.displayText: You're in the Medical Department of the Oasis Zoo.

spans.text: You're in the Medical Department of the Oasis Zoo.

units.rawText: Since when did the Oasis have a z— mfffff!
units.displayText: Since when did the Oasis have a z— mfffff!

spans.text: Since when did the Oasis have a z— mfffff!

units.rawText: That dispatch assignment must have been tiring, no? Thank you for bringing a new friend back. Here, have some candy.
units.displayText: That dispatch assignment must have been tiring, no? Thank you for bringing a new friend back. Here, have some candy.

spans.text: That dispatch assignment must have been tiring, no? Thank you for bringing a new friend back. Here, have some candy.

units.rawText: <size=28>Hmm, honeydew flavor... I guess that's fine...</size>
units.displayText: Hmm, honeydew flavor... I guess that's fine...

spans.text: Hmm, honeydew flavor... I guess that's fine...

units.rawText: Welcome to the Oasis, Taisch. This will be your new workplace from now on.
units.displayText: Welcome to the Oasis, Taisch. This will be your new workplace from now on.

spans.text: Welcome to the Oasis, Taisch. This will be your new workplace from now on.

units.rawText: My new workplace... The facilities here seem to be in very good repair.
units.displayText: My new workplace... The facilities here seem to be in very good repair.

spans.text: My new workplace... The facilities here seem to be in very good repair.

units.rawText: However, why did I have to come to the Oasis? Was there something wrong with the original zoo?
units.displayText: However, why did I have to come to the Oasis? Was there something wrong with the original zoo?

spans.text: However, why did I have to come to the Oasis? Was there something wrong with the original zoo?

units.rawText: Hear me out, Taisch. After you fell asleep at the aquarium, we waited for a long time, but you didn't wake up.
units.displayText: Hear me out, Taisch. After you fell asleep at the aquarium, we waited for a long time, but you didn't wake up.

spans.text: Hear me out, Taisch. After you fell asleep at the aquarium, we waited for a long time, but you didn't wake up.

units.rawText: Miss Bunny and Arctic Fox fell asleep with you, so we couldn't use them to tell how you were...
units.displayText: Miss Bunny and Arctic Fox fell asleep with you, so we couldn't use them to tell how you were...

spans.text: Miss Bunny and Arctic Fox fell asleep with you, so we couldn't use them to tell how you were...

units.rawText: Imhotep and Max were worried about you and felt that delaying any further might cause you harm, so after a quick discussion, we decided to bring you back here.
units.displayText: Imhotep and Max were worried about you and felt that delaying any further might cause you harm, so after a quick discussion, we decided to bring you back here.

spans.text: Imhotep and Max were worried about you and felt that delaying any further might cause you harm, so after a quick discussion, we decided to bring you back here.

units.rawText: Fortunately, a series of tests revealed that your neural cloud was much more stable than we expected, enough for you to work in the Oasis.
units.displayText: Fortunately, a series of tests revealed that your neural cloud was much more stable than we expected, enough for you to work in the Oasis.

spans.text: Fortunately, a series of tests revealed that your neural cloud was much more stable than we expected, enough for you to work in the Oasis.

units.rawText: The Oasis' zoo... What is it like?
units.displayText: The Oasis' zoo... What is it like?

spans.text: The Oasis' zoo... What is it like?

units.rawText: Well... We don't actually have a zoo at the moment. We just began planning it today and it isn't built yet.
units.displayText: Well... We don't actually have a zoo at the moment. We just began planning it today and it isn't built yet.

spans.text: Well... We don't actually have a zoo at the moment. We just began planning it today and it isn't built yet.

units.rawText: Can I entrust you with building and managing the zoo, Taisch?
units.displayText: Can I entrust you with building and managing the zoo, Taisch?

spans.text: Can I entrust you with building and managing the zoo, Taisch?

units.rawText: Hm... I get it. Since a new zoo needs me, I can probably stay here...
units.displayText: Hm... I get it. Since a new zoo needs me, I can probably stay here...

spans.text: Hm... I get it. Since a new zoo needs me, I can probably stay here...

units.rawText: Was that what you decided for me?
units.displayText: Was that what you decided for me?

spans.text: Was that what you decided for me?

units.rawText: Yup, we'll be working together from now on.
units.displayText: Yup, we'll be working together from now on.

spans.text: Yup, we'll be working together from now on.

units.rawText: The bunny that was lying in Taisch's arms has awakened at some point. Its furry body squirms in Taisch's embrace for a while until it settles into a comfortable position.
units.displayText: The bunny that was lying in Taisch's arms has awakened at some point. Its furry body squirms in Taisch's embrace for a while until it settles into a comfortable position.

spans.text: The bunny that was lying in Taisch's arms has awakened at some point. Its furry body squirms in Taisch's embrace for a while until it settles into a comfortable position.

units.rawText: Ah, Miss Bunny's awake. Are you and Arctic Fox alright?
units.displayText: Ah, Miss Bunny's awake. Are you and Arctic Fox alright?

spans.text: Ah, Miss Bunny's awake. Are you and Arctic Fox alright?

units.rawText: Miss Bunny blinks but does not answer. Instead, she rubs up against Taisch's hand.
units.displayText: Miss Bunny blinks but does not answer. Instead, she rubs up against Taisch's hand.

spans.text: Miss Bunny blinks but does not answer. Instead, she rubs up against Taisch's hand.

units.rawText:
Pyonpyon—
(After returning here, we can't speak to you on the outside any more, Taisch.)
units.displayText:
Pyonpyon—
(After returning here, we can't speak to you on the outside any more, Taisch.)

spans.text:
Pyonpyon—
(After returning here, we can't speak to you on the outside any more, Taisch.)

units.rawText: Ah, so that means... You're already...
units.displayText: Ah, so that means... You're already...

spans.text: Ah, so that means... You're already...

units.rawText: Omnomnom... Sho, what'sh Mish Bunny shaying—
units.displayText: Omnomnom... Sho, what'sh Mish Bunny shaying—

spans.text: Omnomnom... Sho, what'sh Mish Bunny shaying—

units.rawText: Miss Bunny says kids should finish eating before speaking.
units.displayText: Miss Bunny says kids should finish eating before speaking.

spans.text: Miss Bunny says kids should finish eating before speaking.

units.rawText: ... (Bear with it...)
units.displayText: ... (Bear with it...)

spans.text: ... (Bear with it...)

units.rawText: (Snap.)
units.displayText: Snap.

spans.text: Snap.

units.rawText: What the heck?! You're the one who's least qualified to call someone else a kid here!!
units.displayText: What the heck?! You're the one who's least qualified to call someone else a kid here!!

spans.text: What the heck?! You're the one who's least qualified to call someone else a kid here!!

units.rawText: Some time later, in the Command Center.
units.displayText: Some time later, in the Command Center.

spans.text: Some time later, in the Command Center.

units.rawText: While I know you've always respected everyone's opinions, I didn't expect you to approve something like a zoo.
units.displayText: While I know you've always respected everyone's opinions, I didn't expect you to approve something like a zoo.

spans.text: While I know you've always respected everyone's opinions, I didn't expect you to approve something like a zoo.

units.rawText: Well, since we've got a fairground and a shopping street, a small zoo won't hurt. Everyone's interested in the idea as well, aren't they?
units.displayText: Well, since we've got a fairground and a shopping street, a small zoo won't hurt. Everyone's interested in the idea as well, aren't they?

spans.text: Well, since we've got a fairground and a shopping street, a small zoo won't hurt. Everyone's interested in the idea as well, aren't they?

units.rawText: Hehe... Indeed, Professor. Still, it was also the best choice to help Taisch maintain her cognitive stability.
units.displayText: Hehe... Indeed, Professor. Still, it was also the best choice to help Taisch maintain her cognitive stability.

spans.text: Hehe... Indeed, Professor. Still, it was also the best choice to help Taisch maintain her cognitive stability.

units.rawText: She's doing much better now thanks to Imhotep and Max... Although I wonder what she went through in the past.
units.displayText: She's doing much better now thanks to Imhotep and Max... Although I wonder what she went through in the past.

spans.text: She's doing much better now thanks to Imhotep and Max... Although I wonder what she went through in the past.

units.rawText: I saw the report Imhotep sent me. Taisch is a good girl.
units.displayText: I saw the report Imhotep sent me. Taisch is a good girl.

spans.text: I saw the report Imhotep sent me. Taisch is a good girl.

units.rawText: All she needs is a little kindness and a little companionship. As long as we hold her hand, she can move forward, step by step.
units.displayText: All she needs is a little kindness and a little companionship. As long as we hold her hand, she can move forward, step by step.

spans.text: All she needs is a little kindness and a little companionship. As long as we hold her hand, she can move forward, step by step.

units.rawText: If she keeps living with us like this, we'll be able to figure out those little secrets someday.
units.displayText: If she keeps living with us like this, we'll be able to figure out those little secrets someday.

spans.text: If she keeps living with us like this, we'll be able to figure out those little secrets someday.

units.rawText: Indeed. Angela likes her too. She said she knows a lot of interesting little nursery rhymes and...
units.displayText: Indeed. Angela likes her too. She said she knows a lot of interesting little nursery rhymes and...

spans.text: Indeed. Angela likes her too. She said she knows a lot of interesting little nursery rhymes and...

units.rawText: WHAM—
units.displayText: WHAM—

spans.text: WHAM—

units.rawText: The door to the Command Center suddenly flies open, and two excited Dolls suddenly barge inside.
units.displayText: The door to the Command Center suddenly flies open, and two excited Dolls suddenly barge inside.

spans.text: The door to the Command Center suddenly flies open, and two excited Dolls suddenly barge inside.

units.rawText: Professor—! I heard you brought a new Doll back, is she the one from that popular topic a while back?
units.displayText: Professor—! I heard you brought a new Doll back, is she the one from that popular topic a while back?

spans.text: Professor—! I heard you brought a new Doll back, is she the one from that popular topic a while back?

units.rawText: You know, the one in the bizarre abandoned zoo?
units.displayText: You know, the one in the bizarre abandoned zoo?

spans.text: You know, the one in the bizarre abandoned zoo?

units.rawText: Get lost, I was here first! Professor, Professor, everyone's saying you did something big, is that true?
units.displayText: Get lost, I was here first! Professor, Professor, everyone's saying you did something big, is that true?

spans.text: Get lost, I was here first! Professor, Professor, everyone's saying you did something big, is that true?

units.rawText: They say you brought that weird zoo to the Oasis!
units.displayText: They say you brought that weird zoo to the Oasis!

spans.text: They say you brought that weird zoo to the Oasis!

units.rawText: Ah, that's just a rumor...
units.displayText: Ah, that's just a rumor...

spans.text: Ah, that's just a rumor...

units.rawText: Then what about that Oasis Zoo everyone was talking about on the forums? They say it's got a zookeeper too!
units.displayText: Then what about that Oasis Zoo everyone was talking about on the forums? They say it's got a zookeeper too!

spans.text: Then what about that Oasis Zoo everyone was talking about on the forums? They say it's got a zookeeper too!

units.rawText: Well, we're definitely going to have a zoo. However, that's just...
units.displayText: Well, we're definitely going to have a zoo. However, that's just...

spans.text: Well, we're definitely going to have a zoo. However, that's just...

units.rawText: I TOLD you, right? My sources are never wrong!
units.displayText: I TOLD you, right? My sources are never wrong!

spans.text: I TOLD you, right? My sources are never wrong!

units.rawText: Ohhhhh! That IS a big scoop! When's the zoo opening? What are the attractions?
units.displayText: Ohhhhh! That IS a big scoop! When's the zoo opening? What are the attractions?

spans.text: Ohhhhh! That IS a big scoop! When's the zoo opening? What are the attractions?

units.rawText: Are there going to be, oh, swimming elephants, man-eating lions, and... hang on, let me check my notes!
units.displayText: Are there going to be, oh, swimming elephants, man-eating lions, and... hang on, let me check my notes!

spans.text: Are there going to be, oh, swimming elephants, man-eating lions, and... hang on, let me check my notes!

units.rawText: ...Please don't let yourself get carried away by online rumors, Miss Reporter...
units.displayText: ...Please don't let yourself get carried away by online rumors, Miss Reporter...

spans.text: ...Please don't let yourself get carried away by online rumors, Miss Reporter...

units.rawText: Hehe... Then you should open the zoo ASAP and let everyone see for themselves, no?
units.displayText: Hehe... Then you should open the zoo ASAP and let everyone see for themselves, no?

spans.text: Hehe... Then you should open the zoo ASAP and let everyone see for themselves, no?

units.rawText: Yeah, that's right! I heard there's a suuuuuper cute zookeeper there too, let us visit already—!
units.displayText: Yeah, that's right! I heard there's a suuuuuper cute zookeeper there too, let us visit already—!

spans.text: Yeah, that's right! I heard there's a suuuuuper cute zookeeper there too, let us visit already—!

units.rawText: The Oasis is so lively.
units.displayText: The Oasis is so lively.

spans.text: The Oasis is so lively.

units.rawText: I'm sure we'll be able to get lots of visitors in a place like this, even without the alicorn's blessing.
units.displayText: I'm sure we'll be able to get lots of visitors in a place like this, even without the alicorn's blessing.

spans.text: I'm sure we'll be able to get lots of visitors in a place like this, even without the alicorn's blessing.

units.rawText: My personal private miracle has appeared, isn't that right, <color=orange>Miss Bunny?</color>
units.displayText: My personal private miracle has appeared, isn't that right, Miss Bunny?

spans.text: My personal private miracle has appeared, isn't that right,
Miss Bunny?

units.rawText:
<color=orange>"The mermaid sings, and Bigfoot sleeps."</color>
<color=orange>"Beneath the dark waters, atop the snowy peaks."</color>
units.displayText:
"The mermaid sings, and Bigfoot sleeps."
"Beneath the dark waters, atop the snowy peaks."

spans.text: "The mermaid sings, and Bigfoot sleeps."
"Beneath the dark waters, atop the snowy peaks."

units.rawText:
<color=orange>"The alicorn folds its wings, the golem slowly stirs."</color>
<color=orange>"In the rowdy jungle, atop the silent tower..."</color>
units.displayText:
"The alicorn folds its wings, the golem slowly stirs."
"In the rowdy jungle, atop the silent tower..."

spans.text: "The alicorn folds its wings, the golem slowly stirs."
"In the rowdy jungle, atop the silent tower..."

units.rawText: As Taisch thinks, she sings the now-complete nursery rhyme.
units.displayText: As Taisch thinks, she sings the now-complete nursery rhyme.

spans.text: As Taisch thinks, she sings the now-complete nursery rhyme.
